blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The student behind the shooting incident at the Banga National High School in South Cotabato was a good kid that got exposed to the deep web and Satanism, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said on Tuesday. Remulla said in an ambush interview at the Batasang Pambansa complex that the student, whom he called by the name “Lucky,” was an honor student who had a girlfriend and friends.
